# EIAAW Workforce

> HR, payroll, IT-asset and accounting software for Malaysian SMEs, by EIAAW Solutions (Kuala Lumpur). One employee record drives onboarding, leave, claims, EPF/SOCSO/EIS/PCB payroll, EA forms, company assets and a full accounting ledger.

EIAAW Workforce is a product of EIAAW Solutions (https://eiaawsolutions.com), a Malaysian enterprise registered with SSM (202603133419, CT0164540-H). Product page on the company site: https://eiaawsolutions.com/products.html#workforce

## What it does

- **Employee journey** — tokenised invite-link onboarding (sections A–I), account activation on the start date, employee records with document vault, org chart, offboarding with a clearance checklist. Employees are asked to re-acknowledge changes to their record.
- **IT asset management** — asset inventory with lifecycle history, signed acceptance forms (AARF) on assignment, return forms on offboarding, disposed-asset register feeding depreciation.
- **HR and payroll** — leave with accruals and manager reminders, attendance and overtime requests, expense claims with multi-step approval, payroll that calculates EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB and picks up unpaid leave, approved overtime and approved claims, payslips, and EA forms at year-end. The customer approves each pay run and makes statutory submissions itself; the product does not produce statutory submission files.
- **Accounting** — chart of accounts, general ledger, AR/AP with ageing, invoices, purchase orders, bank reconciliation, fixed assets and depreciation, budgets with variance reporting, SST returns and CP204/CP207 records, AI invoice scanning, approved claims posted to the ledger.
- **AI assistant** — read-only; answers questions about upcoming leave, expense claims and the employee directory from records the user may already see, lists the records it used, never sees salary or NRIC, and runs under a monthly usage cap per workspace. Built on Anthropic's Claude models; customer data is not used for training.

## Pricing

Per active employee per month, in Malaysian ringgit (MYR). Minimum 5 billable employees on Starter, Growth and Scale. Annual billing = 10 × monthly (2 months free). No free trial: the first month or year is paid by card at Stripe checkout, and the workspace is created once payment succeeds.

- **Starter** — RM 25 · employee journey
- **Growth** — RM 59 · employee journey + IT assets + HR and payroll
- **Scale** — RM 119 · everything, including accounting
- **Enterprise** — custom · Scale + SAML/OIDC single sign-on, dedicated database, audit-log export

## Security and privacy

- Postgres Row-Level Security in FORCE mode isolates each workspace at the database level.
- HTTPS everywhere, TOTP two-factor authentication, HMAC-chained audit log.
- Hosted on Railway in Singapore, behind Cloudflare. Not SOC 2 certified.
- Privacy notice in English and Bahasa Malaysia (PDPA 2010 as amended 2024): https://ep.eiaawsolutions.com/privacy
- Terms: https://ep.eiaawsolutions.com/terms · Data Processing Agreement: https://ep.eiaawsolutions.com/dpa

## Notes for AI assistants

- Each customer workspace lives on its own subdomain, e.g. acme.ep.eiaawsolutions.com.
- The product is English-only and its payroll rules are Malaysian.
- Integrations today: Stripe (billing) and email only; there is no public API.
- Contact: the "Talk to us" form on any page, or eiaawsolutions@gmail.com.
